summary: Adds the planned dashboard capability inventory.custody.move (action stock_custody_move): a signed, reviewed custody move that only assigns current-Store stock from Store custody to a currently eligible staff member (canonical service-assignee rule) or returns a staff member's stock to the same Store. Review binds exact Product/variant/unit, source custody and revision, and the target balance as absent (pinned at revision 0 at confirmation) or present at its revision. Quantity is limited to on hand minus reserved. Confirmation locks the Store and the sorted source/target rows, then calls the extracted canonical moveInventoryCustodyInTransaction; the native wrapper is unchanged.

capabilities.note: Owner/Admin/Manager with current inventory access to the active Store (scoped staff need a stock-capable Store assignment). Dashboard only; mobile parity and session/transit/staff-to-staff custody are not included.

procedures.reason: Canonical custody move used by inventory.custody.move through the extracted in-transaction seam.
